verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents its own AI features that produce insights from workspace data: root-cause analysis of destination delivery errors, detection of duplicate or typo'd event names, and natural-language pipeline monitoring. However, these are delivered through its MCP server in external AI clients or through a Slack agent, not a documented in-app experience. The insights also mostly cover pipeline and data-quality health rather than customer-data analytics. Missing for 10: a documented in-product AI insights or suggestions UI, AI insights on customer/business data beyond the vague homepage chat claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Investigate destination delivery errors and get root cause analysis
